description: Policy Pack vectors: pack validity (P1) and deterministic most-restrictive-wins merge with forbidden-override detection (P2). P3 (auditability) is operational and remains future work.

P1.name: Pack Validity
P1.description: JCS canonicalization and JWS signature of published packs

P2.name: Enforcement
P2.description: Deterministic merge: witnesses/finality higher, retention/caps lower; forbidden overrides rejected
focus_areas: Overlay MUST NOT weaken min_witnesses below root (section 4)

P3.name: Auditability
P3.description: Verifiable decision logs tied to packs (operational; future work)
